articles.title: Augmont Enterprises IPO Listing: Stock Debuts 22% Higher, Hits ₹1,000; Hold Or Book Profits?
articles.description: Augmont Enterprises made a strong stock market debut, listing at ₹961 on NSE, a 22% premium over its IPO price. The stock saw follow-up buying and crossed the ₹1,000 mark, delivering nearly 28% gains for investors at the day’s peak. Pawan Nahar, Business Today, explains why the listing was below the roughly 35% premium indicated by the grey market. Recent weakness in gold prices weighed on sentiment around the precious-metals platform. Despite the strong debut, brokerage firms remain positive on Augmont for the long term, citing rising demand for precious metals in India. Investors now face the key question: hold the stock or book listing gains?

articles.title: INS Nipun Commissioned: Indian Navy Gets New Underwater Power | What Makes This New Vessel Special?
articles.description: The Indian Navy has commissioned INS Nipun, its second Diving Support Vessel, at the Naval Dockyard in Mumbai, marking a significant addition to the Navy’s specialised underwater capabilities.Built by Hindustan Shipyard Limited (HSL), INS Nipun is designed to support a range of complex underwater operations, including saturation diving, air diving and mixed-gas/heliox diving.The vessel can also deploy Remotely Operated Vehicles (ROVs) and support operations involving a Deep Submergence Rescue Vehicle (DSRV), strengthening India’s ability to conduct deep-sea operations, underwater search and rescue and specialised diving missions.The commissioning of INS Nipun further strengthens the Indian Navy’s underwater support infrastructure and reflects India’s growing shipbuilding capabilities under the Atmanirbhar Bharat initiative.Watch the key features and capabilities of INS Nipun. -News18 is your trusted source for breaking news, updates, and in-depth analysis from around the world. articles.title: Canadian billionaire Kevin O’Leary gives a blunt warning to startup founders: Cut losses and avoid spending more money on businesses that are not
articles.description: Kevin O'Leary emphasizes the importance of startup founders acknowledging early failures in their business journey. With around eighty percent of startups facing failure, it's crucial for entrepreneurs to not be weighed down by each setback.
